title: Legibility Is Not Deployability: Four Gates for LLM-Assisted Prediction-Market Trading
description: Paper 2 from Abel AI Lab, v0.2.0. The artifact contains the manuscript (Markdown + LaTeX), all 12 cited references, an Evidence Locator that maps every numeric claim to a source artifact, the 17-row cross-campaign aggregate that defines the corpus, ancillary registries (52 strict-parsed peer attacks, 225 alternative-routes decisions, 40 verbatim quote rows, 21 manuscript self-attacks), and engineering primitives from a terminated Path C campaign. The paper distills four operational gates (sourceability, fillability, capacity, anchor stability) that repeatedly erased apparent LLM-accessible edges, formalizes ceiling-pin layer migration, and documents an adversarial R0 program-gate protocol. Scope is a single-lab, single-period failure-preserving corpus.
notes: Metadata for Zenodo DOI registration after a v0.2.0 release tag is created. arXiv preprint identifier added when assigned. The v0.1.0 release used the title 'Boundaries of Retail Quantitative Trading on Prediction Markets: A Multi-Mechanism Empirical Retrospective'.
